name: Grayscale Screen
summary: Applies a one-toggle grayscale filter to the whole page, which doubles as a crude check for places where color alone carries meaning.
browsersNote: No Firefox or Edge listing found on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Quickly seeing whether a page still works when color is removed.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: grayscale grayscale converter vision deficiency simulation filter accessibility
